description: Ministry of Finance - Strategic Development Projects Act No. 14 of 2008  to Construct five vertical Iconic Towers at the Colombo Port City
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a strategic development project and the granting of tax exemptions and regulatory concessions under the Strategic Development Projects Act. It focuses on legal/regulatory matters including amendments to tax laws (Inland Revenue Act, VAT Act) and establishes a regulatory framework for the project's implementation, rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
